rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for either using gentler wording or naming the gentler word or phrase itself.

example.traditional: 將「死」講成「離世」，係一種委婉講法。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 sei2 gong2 sing4 lei4 sai3 hai6 jat1 zung2 wai2 jyun2 gong2 faat3

rows.jyutping: hou2 teng1 di1 ge3 gong2 faat3
rows.note: Use this casual expression when stressing that the wording sounds nicer or less harsh than the blunt alternative.

example.english: Calling someone fat “a bit fleshy” is a euphemism.
example.traditional: 將「肥」講成「有啲肉地」，聽落係好聽啲嘅講法。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 fei4 gong2 sing4 jau5 di1 juk6 dei2 teng1 lok6 hai6 hou2 teng1 di1 ge3 gong2 faat3

rows.note: Use this more technical term when referring specifically to an individual euphemistic word or phrase.

example.jyutping: lei4 sai3 hai6 ceoi2 doi6 sei2 ge3 wai2 jyun2 jyu5
